evidence: Lighthouse reported '[aria-hidden="true"] elements contain focusable descendants' and showed interactive button/link descendants.
user_impact: Screen-reader users may not be informed about interactive elements that remain keyboard-focusable inside content hidden from assistive technology.
recommended_fix: Review aria-hidden usage; remove inappropriate aria-hidden or ensure hidden interactive descendants cannot receive focus.

evidence: During keyboard-only testing, the interactive card could be reached with Tab and activated with Enter, but no visible focus outline was observed.
user_impact: Keyboard users may have difficulty identifying which interactive element currently has focus.
recommended_fix: Provide a clearly visible :focus-visible state for the interactive card/control with sufficient contrast.

evidence: Lighthouse 'Improve image delivery' insight estimated 1,749 KiB of potential savings.
user_impact: Large or inefficient image downloads can increase loading time and affect perceived performance.
recommended_fix: Serve appropriately sized responsive images, use efficient formats where appropriate, and lazy-load below-the-fold images.

evidence: Lighthouse 'Layout shift culprits' identified an element moving during page load without user interaction.
user_impact: Unexpected movement can make the interface visually unstable and may contribute to accidental clicks.
recommended_fix: Reserve space for images/dynamic content and define predictable dimensions or aspect-ratio for media containers.

evidence: Lighthouse 'Network dependency tree' reported a maximum critical-path latency of 1,188 ms and displayed a navigation → /manifest.json dependency.
user_impact: Long critical request chains can delay resources needed during initial page loading.
recommended_fix: Reduce critical dependencies, defer non-critical resources, reduce resource sizes, and review whether manifest loading needs to be on the critical path.
